 o Build distributed infrastructure to process scientific experiments on large datasets

 o Python and JavaScript on the back-end (Node.js) 
 o Databases (Mongo, Redis) 
 o Container-based deploy (Docker, Quay, Amazon ECS) 
 o Cloud services (Amazon EC2, S3, SQS, Heroku) 
 o Cluster management (Kubernetes, Shipyard, Apache Meso) 
 o Continuous integration 
 o System administration skills 
 o Experience designing, documenting, building, and scaling APIs in a production environment 
 o Ability to identify and fix distributed bottlenecks and bugs 
 o Curiosity and intellectual flexibility 
 o Team oriented with an appetite for adventure
